Actually simpler: bar-track becomes the bar container of fixed width (100% of flex area) but with no background; inside, a bar of width percentage. Then value text after the bar end — but the value width would be placed at the bar end, which is fine and readable. Hmm, but then the flex:1 track's width is same for both rows, so bar widths proportional. Good. Let me use: ``` .bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;} .bar-k{width:64px;flex:none;...} .bar-track{position:relative;flex:1;height:22px;} /* no background */ .bar-track i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:100%;display:block;} .bar-v{...} /* fixed width at right end */ ``` If bar-v has fixed width at row end, it's fine — it stays at consistent right position, and bar lengths still proportional.
